It processed only the first triangle mentioned and did not parallelize the function calls despite having all necessary parameters for both triangles in the user's input.",

Guidance:

- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.
